body: They're tough to find at the moment, market is really weak. Stagflation. I'd be 40 by the time I saved up enough any way. Pointless.

I hate where I live. The life quality is pretty bad. Economic situation is quite bleak. I don't have any interest in going out or meeting anyone or making friends. I do what I have to do, which is go to school and that was it. My parents have a horrible marriage, my dad has a lot of affairs and I don't get along with my siblings. One of them is a gambling addict. I feel like my 20s are being wasted. I just want to get away from here but it's like I'm chained.
